hints.title: Pattern Validation Across Records
hints.text: Phone numbers must conform strictly to two distinct standard notations without extraneous leading or trailing characters. How can lines matching either specification be isolated from invalid text?

hints.title: Anchored Regular Expression Filter
hints.text: Line filtering tools support regular expression patterns. Anchoring expressions to both start and end boundaries ensures partial matches on malformed lines are rejected.

hints.title: Regex Disjunction with Grep
hints.text: Use grep -E with line anchors ^ and $ to match either format: three digits enclosed in parentheses followed by a space and standard four-digit suffix, or three digits separated by hyphens. Print matching lines directly from file.txt.

variables: L: total characters across all lines
complexity.notes: Deterministic finite automaton regular expression scan over lines.
